label: neiso caiso156 meter screen
definition: PROMOTED TO NEISO KEEPER at caiso-159 (2026-08-03). Determination CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS -- IDENTICAL to the neiso-72 incumbent on every criterion, every grade-summary field and the C1 headline (all 12/12, free 8/8). caiso-156 arm B (treatment): POST-FIX CT heat-rate artifact with the hour-grain physical-band screen applied, solved cold per ADDENDUM B against a same-HEAD control. Seven ScenarioConfig fields differ from the committed neiso72_hy_window_B keeper and ALL SEVEN are schema drift, not a config change: each was ADDED to ScenarioConfig after the neiso-72 solve, each defaults to False, and this arm records every one as False. The delta is the CONTENT of the shared measured CT heat-rate artifact the keeper already consumes: scripts/data/derive_campd_ct_heat_rates.py declares a physical band [6.0, 25.0] MMBtu/MWh but applied it ONLY to the plant aggregate, so individual loaded hours at physically impossible heat rates -- a meter artifact, not generation behaviour -- were averaged into the plant rate and diluted it LOW (the caiso-146 section 2.4 defect). The screen now applies the module's OWN declared band per loaded hour and evaluates the _MIN_LOADED_HOURS trust gate on the in-band hours. ZERO NEW PARAMETERS and ZERO ScenarioConfig surface: cap percentile, loaded fraction, all-hours gross_mwh weights, parasitic conversion, the plant-aggregate flag and the flag=='ok' application rule are untouched.
